source_request: [$photo-prompt-image-generator](/Users/chasoik/Projects/image-prompt/skills/photo-prompt-image-generator/SKILL.md) 골반과 허벅지를 클로즈업하여 사이갭을 강조한 청바지 핫팬츠와 크롭티 컨셉 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘
interpreted_intent: A sensual but refined adult denim fashion editorial that uses a pelvis-and-thigh close-up and a natural standing pose to make the negative space between the upper inner thighs visually prominent.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman fashion model wearing denim hot pants and a crop top.
event: The model stands in a relaxed contrapposto with her pelvis slightly angled and one knee subtly forward.
visual_priorities: The hips, denim shorts, upper thighs, and clear inner-thigh negative space dominate the frame.
The result remains polished, anatomically natural, and recognizably editorial.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a polished sensual fashion photograph of an unmistakably adult woman model in a minimalist daylight studio. She stands in a relaxed contrapposto, pelvis angled slightly toward the camera with one knee subtly forward, forming a clear natural band of negative space between her upper inner thighs. Frame a tight close-up from just below the bust to mid-thigh, making her hips and thighs the dominant subject. She wears high-waisted frayed blue denim hot pants and a fitted white crop top, with the lower edge visible above the waistband. Soft side light shapes the denim texture, waistline, hip curve, and thigh contours while keeping the image refined and editorial.
